title: Kissed Sweet Tunisian Date Tagine
description: A sweet and chewy Tunisian dish featuring bacon lardon and dates, simmered in a flavorful nimono broth, served in a traditional cazuela vessel.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cut the bacon lardon into small pieces and cook in a skillet over medium heat until crispy.
Remove the bacon from the skillet and set aside, leaving the grease in the skillet.
Add the sliced onion to the skillet and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the grated ginger to the skillet and cook for an additional 1 minute.
Add the cinnamon stick, honey, olive oil, chicken broth, salt, and black pepper to the skillet and stir to combine.
Add the pitted dates to the skillet and stir to coat with the nimono broth.
Transfer the mixture to a traditional Tunisian cazuela vessel and top with the cooked bacon lardon.
Cover the vessel with a lid and transfer to the preheated oven.
Bake for 25 minutes, or until the dates are tender and the sauce has thickened.
Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F before serving.
